title: Leyendecker Exhibit in NYC
content: There's a exhibition of J.C. Leyendecker originals currently at theNational Arts Clubin New York through January 19th."Leyendecker (March 23, 1874 – July 25, 1951) was one of the pre-eminent American illustrators of the early 20th century. He is best known for his poster, book and advertising illustrations, the trade character known as The Arrow Collar Man, and his numerous covers for The Saturday Evening Post."Exhibit:J.C.
